scope: Existing V15.0 research continuation only; unchanged Road5->Road6 and B51-13->14. R51-only hypothesized occluder 16/24 counterfactual and one nonrepeating nearer open-gorge cross-section.

method.model: R41 approximate pinhole/perspective-correct software z buffer, no GL alpha/cull/fog/shading, near-plane crossing omitted; group mask/visibility pixels are approximate only. Original R49 screenshot background is genuine previous Chromium/WebGL2; hypothetical colorful overlays are not.
method.counterfactual: In-memory exclusion of nonprotected research groups 16 and 24 only; NO original mesh or game code modified. Also isolate 16-only, 24-only and protected-8-only to attribute obstruction.

studyA_r51IdentifiedSite.name: One near-bank open gravity-drop hypothesis at previously identified R51 d200 t163 y72 receiver
studyA_r51IdentifiedSite.interpretation: R51 last-blocker claim is causally sharpened: for this specific receiver, group24 is necessary for complete obstruction in all three offline frames, with group16 partially occluding as well. However recovered receiver is a strip only 6/8/10 approximate original-screen pixels tall and feed only 4-6 pixels tall. Two-dimensional presence fails semantic source/drop/catchment evidence; color-coded projection resembles orange slab over thin purple edge in screen review.
studyA_r51IdentifiedSite.unproven: Original WebGL2 rendering of a real replacement DCC; physical source connection; working gate or supportive geology; human recognition and B51 fairness

studyB_nearerOpenGorge.name: Distinct nearer open-cut 41m fall at local Road6 t70 d143..205, lower catchment t36..70 d151..232 Y52
studyB_nearerOpenGorge.interpretation: Closer waterfall face has nonzero projected influence, but protected forebay19/tower12 occlude lower water even if nonprotected16/24 are excluded. Therefore simply replacing groups16/24 at this cross-section does not yield visual causal sequence.

criticalDecision.reason: Removing nonprotected 16/24 does recover a small amount of projected downstream water at the R51 best site, but real-source view is still dominated by a narrow horizontal cyan strip and unrecognizable feed/drop/catchment. The different near-camera open-cut variant loses its catchment behind protected19 and 12. Neither one earns a true DCC/CI expense.
criticalDecision.bounds: Two finite cross-section counterfactuals over three original camera timestamps only, not an all-sites impossibility theorem. Approximate software depth does not certify native GL result.
criticalDecision.next: Do not iterate tiny R48/R49/R51 water colors/pipes or add another CI just to prove pixels. A fundamentally different anchored sightline must be grounded in source-native camera while protecting 19/12 and B51; only if time-sequential water and mechanical support have convincing screen-space justification make one editable Blender scene and native RAW. No approval is implied for game/camera/protected groups changes.
